llm.summary: This is an instruction-only browser hygiene and interaction guidance skill whose requirements and instructions are consistent with its stated purpose and do not request unexpected credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe browser operations and the SKILL.md contains only rules and heuristics for tab management, perception-first interaction, proof rules, and fallback ladders — all directly related to a browser-operations skill. No unrelated binaries, env vars, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to inspect tabs, perceive page state, take one action and verify results — behavior that fits a browser operations skill. The file does not instruct reading arbitrary filesystem paths, exporting data to third-party endpoints, or accessing credentials. It does mention using 'platform adapters' or an 'MCP server' as higher-level tools when available; this is a reasonable architecture note but those integrations are not configured or invoked by this SKILL.md itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This is low-risk because nothing is written to disk or downloaded by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no primary credential, and no config paths. It therefore does not ask for disproportionate secrets or privileges beyond normal browser control required by an agent platform.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and default autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default). The skill does not request persistent system-wide changes or access to other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and focused on safe browser-driving heuristics. Because it is instruction-only it does not itself fetch code or request secrets. Before installing, confirm (1) the skill author/source (homepage is provided but source repo is unknown) if provenance matters to you, and (2) that any platform adapters, MCP servers, or site-specific skills you pair this with are trusted — those other components may require credentials or network access that this SKILL.md does not declare. If you intend the agent to act on real accounts, restrict and audit those account credentials separately.
